description: Patbingsu is a beloved Korean shaved ice dessert, perfect for cooling down on a hot day. It features a mound of finely shaved ice topped with sweet red bean paste, chewy tteok (rice cakes), condensed milk, and various fruits or syrups. This refreshing treat offers a delightful combination of textures and flavors, from the creamy red beans to the icy crunch.

instructions.title: Prepare the Milk Ice Base
instructions.text: In a bowl, combine 2 cups of whole milk and 2 tablespoons of sugar (if using). Stir until the sugar dissolves completely. Pour the sweetened milk into ice cube trays and freeze for at least 4-6 hours, or preferably overnight, until solid.

instructions.title: Cook Mini Tteok
instructions.text: If using dried mini tteok, boil them in water for 2-3 minutes until they become soft and chewy. Drain the tteok and rinse under cold water to prevent sticking. Set aside.

instructions.title: Prepare Toppings
instructions.text: While the milk ice is freezing, prepare your desired toppings. Wash and chop fresh fruits like strawberries, kiwi, or mango into bite-sized pieces. If using Injeolmi, chop them into small cubes. Ensure your sweet red bean paste is ready to use.

instructions.title: Shave the Ice
instructions.text: Once the milk ice cubes are completely frozen, remove them from the trays. Use a shaved ice machine or a powerful blender (with an ice crush setting) to shave or finely crush the milk ice until it resembles fine snow. Work in batches if necessary to achieve the desired texture.

instructions.title: Assemble the Patbingsu
instructions.text: Divide the finely shaved milk ice evenly into individual serving bowls. Gently mound the ice in the center of each bowl, creating a base for your toppings.

instructions.title: Add Toppings
instructions.text: Generously spoon the sweet red bean paste over the center of the shaved ice. Artfully arrange the cooked mini tteok, chopped fresh fruits, and any other desired toppings like Injeolmi or cereal flakes around the red bean paste.

instructions.title: Drizzle and Serve
instructions.text: Drizzle a generous amount of sweetened condensed milk over all the toppings and shaved ice. Serve immediately with a long spoon, encouraging guests to mix a little as they enjoy this refreshing dessert.

tips: For the best, fluffiest texture, invest in a dedicated shaved ice machine. If using a blender, work in short pulses to prevent the ice from melting too quickly.
While store-bought sweet red bean paste is convenient, making it from scratch allows you to control the sweetness and texture, offering a truly authentic flavor.
Experiment with various toppings beyond the traditional: try a scoop of green tea ice cream, a sprinkle of roasted nuts, or different seasonal fruits for a personalized Patbingsu experience.
